category_note: (文章來源:族語e樂園中高級句法演練)
question_amis: Adihay ko tata’akay a konga i sadatengan ni ama haw?
question_ch: 阿嬤的菜園有很多大的地瓜嗎?
suggested_answer_amis: Hai, adihay ko tata'akay a konga i sadatengan ni ama.
suggested_answer_ch: 是的,阿嬤的菜園有很多大的地瓜。

question_amis: Caykanca a ira ko no niyah a niyaro' no kasafinawlan, i cowa ko niyaro' no miso?
question_ch: 每一位族人都有自己的部落,你的部落在哪裡呢？
suggested_answer_amis: Hai, i Posong Kakacawan ko niyaro' no mako.
suggested_answer_ch: 是的,我的部落在台東長濱。

question_amis: Ano ira ko tosiya iso i, icowa ko sakatayraan iso a misalama?
question_ch: 如果你有車子，你會想去哪裡旅遊呢?
suggested_answer_amis: Ano ira ko tosiya ako i, i Posong ko sakatayraan ako a misalama.
suggested_answer_ch: 如果我有車子，我會想去台東旅遊。

question_amis: Ira aca to mihecahecaan ko ilisin no niyaro', mikihatiyaay kiso a mikapot haw?
question_ch: 部落每年都會舉辦豐年祭，你也會話題參加嗎?
suggested_answer_amis: Hai, caay kaeca mikihatiyaay kako a mikapot to mihecahecaan ko ilising no niyaro'
suggested_answer_ch: 是的,我每年總是會參加部落的豐年祭。

question_amis: Mafana'ay kiso a mitilid to tilid no Pangcah? Icowa kiso a minanam?
question_ch: 你會書寫阿美族語嗎?你是在哪裡學習的？
suggested_answer_amis: Hai, mafana'ay kako a mitilid to tilid no Pangcah, i pitilidan kako a minanam.
suggested_answer_ch: 提是的,我會書寫阿美族語,我是在學校學習的。

question_amis: Cecay 'afar mo^etep ko wa'ay, tolo ko 'afar pina ko wa'ay?
question_ch: 一隻蝦子有10隻腳, 3隻蝦子共幾隻腳?
suggested_answer_amis: Tolo ko 'afar tolo polo' ko wa'ay.
suggested_answer_ch: 3隻蝦子共有30隻腳。

question_amis: O maan ko kaolahan iso a miyatayat? Naw?
question_ch: 你喜歡什麼運動?為什麼?
suggested_answer_amis: O miyakiway ko kaolahan ako a miyatayat? O sakanga’ay no tatirengan.
suggested_answer_ch: 我喜歡打捧球,因為可以使身體健康。

question_amis: Mafana' romadiw to radiw no Pangcah kiso haw?
question_ch: 你會唱阿美族的歌謠嗎?
suggested_answer_amis: Hai, mafana' romadiw to radiw no Pangcah kako.
suggested_answer_ch: 是的,我會唱阿美族的歌謠。

question_amis: Mafana' ballen masakero to kero no Pangcah kiso haw?
question_ch: 你會跳阿美族的舞蹈嗎?
suggested_answer_amis: Hai, mafana' masakero to kero no Pangcah kako.
suggested_answer_ch: 是的,我會跳阿美族的舞蹈。

question_amis: Minokay tayra niyaro' i, o maan ko sakakomaenan iso a kakaenen?
question_ch: 回部落時,你會想吃什麼佳餚?
suggested_answer_amis: Minokay tayra niyaro' i, o siraw ato toron ko sakakomaenan ako a kakaenen.
suggested_answer_ch: 回部落時,我會想吃鹹豬肉、麻糬。

question_amis: O satadamaanay ko siraw to sapatala to lafang, cima ko misasiraway i loma'？
question_ch: 醃鹹豬肉是一道特別接待用的食物，家裡有誰會醃嗎?
suggested_answer_amis: Ci ina ko misasiraway i loma' niyam.
suggested_answer_ch: 我們家是媽媽醃鹹豬肉。

question_amis: O kaciherangan ko kaciheci no facidol, komaenay kiso to facidol haw?
question_ch: 麵包果是在夏天結果，你會吃麵包果嗎?
suggested_answer_amis: Hai, maolahay komaen to facidol kako.
suggested_answer_ch: 是的,我喜歡吃麵包果。

question_amis: O masasipadapadangay ko Pangcah, mipadangay kiso to widang iso haw?
question_ch: 阿美族人是會相互幫助的族群,你也會幫助你的朋友嗎?
suggested_answer_amis: Hai, mipadangay kako to widang ako.
suggested_answer_ch: 是的,我也會幫助我的朋友。

question_amis: Halafin to caka saso'araw ato widang, mangalay kiso tayra miliso' to widan haw?
question_ch: 很久沒有見到朋友了，你會想去拜訪朋友嗎?
suggested_answer_amis: Hai, mangalay kako tayra miliso' to widang.
suggested_answer_ch: 是的,我會想去拜訪朋友。

question_amis: Ira ko ongsing i Angcoh a niyaro', tayraay to kiso a mililoc to ongsing? 一般
question_ch: 安通部落有溫泉,你有去泡過溫泉了嗎?
suggested_answer_amis: Caay katayra kako a mililoc to ongsing. Nawhani, awaay ho ko limaw ako tayra.
suggested_answer_ch: 我沒有去泡溫泉,因為我還沒有時間過去。

question_amis: 'Aloman to ko aniniay a tamdaw tayra to roma kanatal palafang, tayraay to kiso to roma kanatal a palafang?
question_ch: 現在有很多人會出國旅遊，你有出國旅遊了嗎?
suggested_answer_amis: Hai, tayraay to kako i Ripon a palafang.
suggested_answer_ch: 是的,我有去過日本旅遊了。

question_amis: Romi'ami'ad malolay mitangtang to sakalahok, cima ko mitangtangay i loma' namo?
question_ch: 每天煮午餐很辛苦,你們家是誰在煮呢?
suggested_answer_amis: Ci mama ko mitangtangay to sakalahok i loma' niyam.
suggested_answer_ch: 我們家是爸爸煮午餐。

question_amis: Adihay ko kaeso'ay a dateng no Pangcah, o maan ko makaenay to no miso?
question_ch: 過期阿美族有很多美味的菜，你有吃過哪些了?
suggested_answer_amis: O dongec, tatokem, kafes, 'aowang, cekiw...ko makaenay to no mako.
suggested_answer_ch: 我吃過的有藤心,龍葵,溪蝦,海膽,苙螺...。

question_amis: Ira i salawacan no niyaro' mapaloma ko tahapinangan a pinarengaw no Pangcah, o maan ko i niyaro'ay namo?
question_ch: 在阿美族的部落會種植象徵的植物，你們的部落有種什麼植物呢?
suggested_answer_amis: O 'icep, facidol, kingking ko pinarengaw i niyaro'ay niyam.
suggested_answer_ch: 在我們的部落有種檳榔樹,麵包樹,龍眼樹。

question_amis: Ira ko mipalomaan a heci no losay i salawacan no loma' namo?
question_ch: 你們家周邊有種什麼水果嗎?
suggested_answer_amis: Ira ko mipaloma'an a kowa' i aikor no loma' niyam.
suggested_answer_ch: 我們家後面有種木瓜。
